name: ZAP
what: An open-source web application security proxy and scanner (ZAP by Checkmarx). It spiders sites, supports passive and active scanning, API/OpenAPI imports and a Docker baseline scan suitable for CI.
when: To test your own web apps in test or staging, to add a passive baseline gate in CI/CD, and as a free alternative or complement when Burp Professional is not available.
example: Start with the passive baseline scan in Docker: `docker run -t ghcr.io/zaproxy/zaproxy:stable zap-baseline.py -t https://staging.contoso.com`.
Mount a working folder and add `-r report.html` so the HTML report lands on disk, as shown in the baseline docs.
For authenticated areas, configure a context and login sequence in the desktop UI before active scanning.
Triage warnings, mark false positives in a config file, and keep active scans off production unless the rules of engagement allow them.
pitfalls: Active scans submit forms and can create data or trigger emails; avoid production.
Without a login configuration ZAP only sees public pages.
The baseline scan is passive and will not replace a manual review or a full active policy.
